# platform-orchestrator_module_version (Resource)

Publishes and manages one immutable Core Module Version. The external artifact definition and SemVer identity are immutable; removing this Terraform resource only forgets it from state because Stellwerk permanently retains published Versions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) JSON ModuleVersionPublishBody containing source, inputs, parameters, provider mappings, dependencies, co-provisioned resources, optional external artifact digest/source revision, and release notes.
- `module_id` (String) Immutable Module technical slug.
- `semantic_version` (String) Canonical SemVer identity. New publications begin Proposed and Unverified.

### Optional

- `lifecycle_status` (String) Desired Core lifecycle status. Valid values are proposed, default, deprecated and defective; transitions remain server validated.
- `transition_reason` (String) Human-readable reason used when lifecycle_status requests a transition after publication.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Immutable Module Version UUID.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic-concurrency version of the lifecycle record.
- `verification_status` (String) Artifact verification state. The first iteration reports unverified without blocking explicit use.
